text:
jen: heads up, deploy-bot put the 2026.03.21 promo on HOLD due to CI pipeline failure during artifact cache restore.
deploy-bot: Promotion held: job=integration-tests, reason=cache restore timed out (504) for /ci/artifacts/2026.03.21/*.tar.gz, attempts=3.
maria: ugh, seen similar when cache index had stale tombstones after GC. I can try a targeted purge + rehydrate.
kevin: before we do anything, what's the delta vs last green? is this a single commit regressing tests or infra?
jen: two commits in the canary. last green was at commit abc123 (two commits back). current head is def456. Tests failing are infra-related: logs show ETag/ETag mismatch during blob mount and then the restore timed out.
sam: can we avoid a rollback if we can rerun just the failing job after a cache purge? rollback during change window is risky because there is a DB migration in flight for the next release.
maria: I'll run a dry purge on the cache index to see which keys are tombstoned. Command I'll run: ```bash
./infra/cachectl lookup --prefix=ci/artifacts/2026.03.21 | jq '.meta | {key, tombstoned, etag}'
```
jen: thanks. if purge + single-job rerun works, we can keep promo pinned but not promote to prod until we get a full green canary.
deploy-bot: Rerun requested by @maria: job=integration-tests (attempt 4) queued.
oncall-bot: Reminder: change window tomorrow 16:00-18:00 UTC for larger rollouts. Any hot rollbacks outside that window need an oncall signoff.
kevin: I'm +1 to purge+rerun. If rerun fails again, we should pin to abc123 and cut a quick rollback PR for the release branch. Sam, can you draft the rollback PR so it's ready?
sam: on it — will open PR in 5. If we pin, note in release notes: "hotfix: pinned image to abc123 due to cache restore instability; will revisit after infra GC fix."
maria: dry lookup returned ~120 tombstoned entries; planning to purge the 3 keys hitting the blob mount. Running: ```bash
./infra/cachectl purge --keys "ci/artifacts/2026.03.21/def456/meta" "ci/artifacts/2026.03.21/def456/blobindex" --confirm
```
jen: good. if rerun succeeds, can we still prevent auto-promote to prod until we manually flip? I want manual approval to avoid surprising rollouts.
deploy-bot: Promotion will remain held until manual approve-promo command: `deploy-bot approve-promo --id 2026-03-21-rc4 --by=human`.
kevin: perfect. maria, please report back within 10m. if rerun fails, sam to create rollback PR and I'll coordinate signoff for out-of-window rollback if necessary.
maria: purge done, rerun started. logs look cleaner so far, fetching artifacts succeeded.
jen: :crossed_fingers:
maria: rerun passed integration-tests. deploying canary should be safe to promote to dedicated but not prod.
sam: rollback PR on standby but not needed. I'll add the release note blurb now.
jen: excellent. leave the promo held for prod until tomorrow change window; add note in release channel and include the pinned-commit info in the release notes draft.
kevin: thanks everyone. Will pair with ops tomorrow for prod flip during change window.
